plotEn:
Following an unexplained apocalyptic event, young Pumpkin lives by herself in her old farmhouse. For the past four years, she has been celebrating Halloween, leaving candy outside, and sending radio messages out in the hopes of someone answering her. Suffering from loneliness, she intends to shoot herself, but gets a brief radio transmission, only to lose it when she accidentally drops the batteries.
After awakening from a nightmare, Pumpkin sees someone actually taking candy from her bowl and chases them, only to lose them. Well into the night, Pumpkin is surprised by the appearance of people in her house. The woman, Thalia, introduces herself, her husband Royce, and a fellow traveler, Wendy, whom Pumpkin saw earlier. While put off by Pumpkin's talkative nature and her current obsession with Halloween, they entertain her and feed her desire for companionship. Thalia leaves to go get the rest of their group, while Royce and Wendy stay to watch Pumpkin. Despite Wendy's rather anti-social personality, she finds common ground with Pumpkin and admits that her favorite Halloween pastime was the hayride with her sister.
Royce soon reveals his aggressive side and takes Pumpkin's gun after seeing that she uses the decomposed bodies of her parents to fill the void of her loneliness. Wendy stabs Royce in the back of the neck and knocks him out. Pumpkin is upset over the carnage, but Wendy reveals that Royce, Thalia and the others are all cannibals, implying that she herself joined them
